_purpose: Per-crop planting and harvest windows for qualified pairs whose countries ASAP's own crop calendar omits. Load-bearing: every in-season claim depends on the harvest date being right, because a reading taken after harvest is not a forecast.
_units: dekads of 36. Dekad 1 is 1-10 January. sos is planting start, harvest_start is the first dekad of harvest. The in-season window runs sos to harvest_start minus one, wrapping through the new year where wraps is true.
_sourced: 2026-07-29, per D-040. Each entry names a source and what it says, so a later chat can re-check it rather than trust it.
